scope: Every equipment cell that was Unverified at the start of this audit; all nine HEV configurations. Existing S/A cells and package names were also rechecked. No PHEV record is changed.
matrixInterpretation: S=Standard; A=Available. Blank is not defined as a negative symbol in this supplied brochure. A package name or another trim’s equipment does not fill a blank. Not-applicable entries are based on the documented HEV powertrain class, not missing S/A marks.

technicalAccess.source: Toyota HEV product-information PDF linked by the official media kit

entries.reason: An explicit maximum-torque row is marked S for this grade. Report the brochure value exactly with its unspecified basis instead of discarding the published datum or inventing an engine/system interpretation.

The supplied brochure contains no configuration-specific fuel-economy ratings. The reviewed Toyota release has conflicting HEV estimates, and the EPA lookup is blocked by the proxy. Do not select a convenient number or label a manufacturer estimate EPA-certified.

Only the general up-to-3,500-lb headline appears in the brochure; the reviewed release does not establish this FWD configuration’s limit. A 900-lb example shown in footnote 12 is not a tow rating. The detailed Toyota specification PDF is blocked.

This trim’s moonroof entries are blank in the HEV S/A matrix. The legend defines S and A but does not define blank as an explicit not-offered symbol. No negative availability claim is established by another reviewed source.

The LE seat row confirms fabric/manual seats, but neither that text nor the unexplained blank explicitly states front-seat heating is not offered. Do not infer absence from another trim’s heated-seat row.
The trim’s seat row does not establish ventilation; the ventilation rows/marks apply to other named grades. No explicit negative availability statement was found for this configuration.

LE has a standard urethane steering-wheel row, while the heated-wheel row is blank for LE. The brochure does not explicitly define that blank as not offered; another trim’s heated/leather wheel cannot establish LE availability.

Resolved as not applicable to the explicitly identified conventional HEV. This field is plug-in-specific; the brochure distinguishes the externally charged PHEV architecture. No PHEV equipment, battery, range or charging time is copied to HEV.

otherFindings.result: Separated Standard tilt/slide moonroof wording from the already listed Optional panoramic version; no optional feature is described as standard.
All eight HEV package-name records retain their brochure grade listings; contents/combined-order rules are not enumerated and remain unverified.
Woodland’s existing manufacturer-estimated 41/35/38 value is preserved with its non-EPA qualifier. The eight other HEV economy cells remain unresolved.
Existing release-supported AWD ratings are preserved; the three FWD ratings remain unresolved. The brochure’s general headline or 900-lb illustrated load is not assigned as a trim-specific limit.
